provenance.paper_title: AUGUSTUS: An LLM-Driven Multimodal Agent System with Contextualized User Memory

evidence.section: Full paper: Storing Concepts in Contextual Memory
evidence.paraphrase: Encoded language-form descriptions; semantic tags; context nodes with modality, timestamp, URL, and embeddings. CoPe search first retrieves concepts from a contextual tree and personalized tag graph, then retrieves concept-relevant context nodes.

evidence.section: Full paper: Storing Concepts in Contextual Memory
evidence.paraphrase: Encoded language-form descriptions; semantic tags; context nodes with modality, timestamp, URL, and embeddings. CoPe search first retrieves concepts from a contextual tree and personalized tag graph, then retrieves concept-relevant context nodes.

Recall memory logs conversations; contextual memory receives new context inserts; in-context memory can be modified. For AUGUSTUS, this specifically supports LLM-mediated memory editing of semantic tags.

evidence.section: Full paper: Stage-2: Store in Memory
evidence.paraphrase: Recall memory logs conversations; contextual memory receives new context inserts; in-context memory can be modified. For AUGUSTUS, this specifically supports explicit deletion or eviction of stored items of semantic tags.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are deliberately linked or jointly consumed by downstream reasoning, generation, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 20): During inference, the operative memory component (semantic tags) changes through LLM-mediated memory editing, explicit deletion or eviction of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
